aviation_incidents.headline: 伏林航空A320特內里費前起落架轉向異常，盤旋處置後落地並拖離跑道
aviation_incidents.summary: 伏林航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機、註冊編號EC-LVV，執行VY-3030航班由巴塞隆納飛往特內里費北部機場（TFN），在進場特內里費時因前起落架轉向出現問題，機組員爬升回到FL070高度等待，依檢查表處置。約30分鐘後，飛機重新定位，降落在30跑道。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Vueling A320 holds over Tenerife with nose gear steering problem, then lands and is towed off runway
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Vueling Airbus A320-200, registration EC-LVV, operating flight VY-3030 from Barcelona to Tenerife Norte, was on approach to Tenerife when the crew climbed back to a hold at FL070 to work the checklists after a problem with the nose gear steering developed. The aircraft then positioned for a landing on runway 30 about 30 minutes after entering the hold.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚抵臺協助繁殖
taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空運送雄性斑哥條紋羚Harris來臺。Harris於美國時間10月26日搭乘貨機自達拉斯機場起飛，並於臺灣時間27日晚間10時26分抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）。長榮航空表示，航程約18個小時，休士頓動物園副園長及保衛員也隨行照料。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air transports male bongo antelope to Taiwan for breeding
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air transported a male bongo antelope named Harris to Taiwan. Harris departed Dallas Airport aboard a cargo aircraft on Oct. 26 U.S. time and arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 10:26 p.m. Taiwan time on Oct. 27. EVA Air said the flight took about 18 hours, with the Houston Zoo's deputy director and an animal-care staff member accompanying and caring for him.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣國籍航空部分歐洲航線飛越俄羅斯領空 交通部表示尊重業者安排
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺灣交通部長陳世凱於10月28日表示，國籍航空公司近期飛往部分歐洲航班飛越俄羅斯領空，航路是由航空公司自行申請，交通部與民航局尊重業者的規劃與安排。民航局管理航線主要針對起點與目的地，實際飛航路徑則尊重航空公司的申請。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwanese Carriers Fly Over Russian Airspace on European Routes, Transport Ministry Says
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai stated on October 28 that Taiwanese airlines recently flew over Russian airspace on select European routes. Chen noted that flight paths are requested independently by the airlines themselves, and the ministry respects their operational arrangements. The Civil Aeronautics Administration manages route origins and destinations, while specific flight paths remain subject to airline applications.

international_aviation.headline: 伊朗航空唯一波音747達2萬飛行週期停飛，首度在伊朗進行D級大修
international_aviation.summary: 伊朗航空證實，旗下唯一一架波音747、編號EP-ICD的747-200複合型機，9月中最後一次飛行後停飛，原因是達到重型維修檢查的飛行週期門檻。據aeroTELEGRAPH報導，這將是伊朗首度進行此類重型維修，包含D級檢查。維修工作9月底展開，伊朗航空執行長塔赫爾·阿卜杜勒海在上週記者會後透過Telegram發文公布相關計畫，他表示這架飛機已達到2萬飛行週期的門檻，必須進行必要的維修步驟才能繼續營運，預估需時1.5至2個月；不過aeroTELEGRAPH引述的伊朗航空最新時程則接近6個月。
international_aviation.headline_en: Iran Air grounds sole Boeing 747 for first heavy maintenance check in Iran amid sanctions
international_aviation.summary_en: Iran Air has confirmed that its sole Boeing 747, a 747-200 Combi registered EP-ICD, last flew in mid-September and will remain grounded for months after reaching the cycle threshold for heavy maintenance checks. According to aeroTELEGRAPH, the work will be the first time such heavy maintenance, including a D-Check, has been done in Iran. The work began in late September. Iran Air CEO Taher Abdolhai announced the plans on Telegram following a press conference last week, saying the aircraft had reached the threshold of 20,000 flight cycles and must undergo the necessary repair steps to continue operating; he estimated the work would take 1.5 to two months, although an updated schedule from Iran Air cited by aeroTELEGRAPH puts the timescale closer to six months.

international_aviation.headline: 波音公佈2026年第三季財報 營收242億美元淨虧損收窄至1.16億
international_aviation.summary: 波音（Boeing）於2026年10月27日公佈2026年第三季財務業績。受惠於國防與服務業務強勁表現，波音該季度營收同比增長4%至242億美元。在財務表現方面，波音第三季淨虧損為1.16億美元，相較於去年同期因777X專案大額計提而導致的53億美元淨虧損大幅收窄。截至該季度末，波音總積壓訂單金額創下7450億美元的歷史新高紀錄。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing Reports Q3 2026 Results as Loss Narrows to $116M and 737 MAX Variants Win Certification
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing reported its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on October 27, 2026, posting a 4% year-on-year increase in total quarterly revenue to $24.2 billion, driven mainly by stronger performance across its defense and services divisions. The aircraft manufacturer recorded a net loss of $116 million for the period, marking a substantial reduction from the $5.3 billion loss recorded during the same period a year earlier, when operations were hit by charges on the 777X program. Driven by continued customer demand, Boeing closed the third quarter with a total company backlog reaching a record $745 billion.

international_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯稱破獲針對莫斯科飛彈防禦系統的近距離無人機攻擊陰謀
international_aviation.summary: 俄羅斯聯邦安全局表示，於2026年10月26日逮捕兩名男子，指控兩人正從俄羅斯境內準備近距離無人機攻擊。據俄方說法，攻擊目標包括莫斯科飛彈防禦系統的一部分與一處電力設施，無人機預計由烏克蘭遠端操控。俄方指控兩人為烏克蘭安全局工作，並從斯摩棱斯克與卡盧加地區的隱藏地點取得第一人稱視角無人機與爆裂物零件，依指示組裝、運往莫斯科地區並啟動，再交由烏克蘭境內操作人員接管。
international_aviation.headline_en: Russia says it foiled close-range drone attack on Moscow missile defenses
international_aviation.summary_en: Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) said on October 26, 2026, that it had arrested two men accused of preparing close-range drone attacks from inside Russia. The alleged targets included part of Moscow's missile defense system and a power facility, and the drones were to be remotely operated from Ukraine, according to the FSB. The agency accused the two men of working for Ukraine's security service, saying they collected first-person-view drones and explosive components from hidden locations in the Smolensk and Kaluga regions, assembled them, transported them to the Moscow region, and launched them before handing control to operators in Ukraine.
